bibliographic-data.invention-title: ÜBERWACHUNG MEHRERER SENSOREN IM LAUFE DER ZEIT ZUM NACHWEIS BEWEGLICHER GEWEBEEIGENSCHAFTEN
SURVEILLANCE DE MULTIPLES CAPTEURS AU FIL DU TEMPS POUR DÉTECTER DES CARACTÉRISTIQUES DE DÉPLACEMENT DE TISSU
MONITORING OF MULTIPLE SENSORS OVER TIME TO DETECT MOVING CHARACTERISTICS OF TISSUE

abstract.p: A surgical instrument includes a wireless transmission system for transmitting at least one of power and a data signal through between an end effector and an instrument housing of the surgical instrument. The surgical instrument includes the sensor monitoring and processing circuit.
